definition_correction.invalid_contract: carry inherited raw score threshold 0.55 across a redefined nuisance score
definition_correction.replacement_contract: bound false nuisance attribution by a fixed false-certainty budget alpha

calibration.threshold_rule: smallest score boundary strictly above the empirical 95th percentile of pooled negative nuisance_process_support; no positive-world score may influence the threshold

stop_rule: freeze nuisance decision contract if held-out false-attribution budgets hold across required negative regimes and no new nuisance-side contradiction type appears; unresolved nuisance worlds remain U
claim_boundary: closed-world decision-risk calibration only; no field threshold or field nuisance accuracy claim
